screenshot_status: Root verified all nine poster categories against the user image: 4/5/7/10/14/12/10/8/4 occurrences, 74 total, 66 unique.
normalization: Cross-category duplicates merged by semantic chart id. Horizontal/vertical lollipop are one recipe variant. Column+line and candlestick/stock-price labels normalized. Geographic proportional symbols remain separate from non-geographic proportional symbols. Proportional stacked bar is not Marimekko.
